text:
Aisha: Concordance asked for a performance PoC. Goal: sustained 400 qps per region for generation requests (avg ~350 tokens, max 512) with customer requirement p95 < 120ms (post-auth). They want Dedicated capacity and will enforce KMS + audit logs. Can we run next week?

Ravi: Sounds doable. Which model size do they prefer? Any restriction on quantization?

Aisha: They said "7B preferred" and open to quantized variants. Regions: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR. Also they want an estimate for monthly committed pricing for Dedicated + VPC option.

Jun: Quick clarifiers: 1) steady-state 30m holds with occasional 5s microbursts? 2) single-turn gen or multi-turn chat? Prefix reuse?

Aisha: Yes steady 30m windows, scattered 5s microbursts. Single-turn generation; many requests share a 64-token prompt prefix.

Jun: Prefix reuse helps. Proposed test plan:
- Model: rwd-open-7b (quantized q8_256 recommended)
- Infra: 2x A10GX dedicated nodes/region + 1 spare node for failover (so ~3 nodes/region allocated)
- Load: ramp 0->400 qps over 5m, hold 30m, inject 10 microbursts of 5s each
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99, tail cold-starts, GPU util, tokens/sec, errors

Jun: Load harness example (k6 + simple client):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m test-script.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
```
Sample line from client logs: 
```
[2026-03-25T18:03:12Z] req=0a1b2c lat_ms=72 status=200 tokens_out=346
[2026-03-25T18:03:13Z] req=0a1b2d lat_ms=110 status=200 tokens_out=352
p95=116ms p99=205ms
```

Ravi: Important: KMS envelope ops can add 4-12ms depending on topology. Concordance insists p95 < 120ms after auth. We should simulate managed KMS in the path and a private/customer-KMS variant.

security-bot: Note: Enabling per-request audit logs is supported; retention and exports can be configured for enterprise trials. Document required roles for log access.

Jun: Two PoC variants recommended: hosted-dedicated (managed KMS) and private-VPC (customer KMS + DirectConnect). Expect private path to add latency (estimate +10-25ms) and longer setup time (+2-3 weeks). We'll run both to show delta.

ops-bot: Tentative infra slot available Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. Requires 48h confirmation.

Aisha: Please tentatively reserve. Also need a ballpark price for dedicated capacity sized for this workload with 99.9% uptime SLA. Include separate estimate for private-VPC egress and networking overhead.

Jun: Back-of-envelope for proposed config: per region 3x A10GX-equivalent (2 active + 1 spare). Expected aggregate tokens/sec ~120k at 400 qps with avg 300 tokens. Hourly cost per A10GX-equivalent = $X/hr -> total ~3*X/hr per region -> both regions ~6*X/hr. Monthly committed price approx $Z/month for 12mo term after discounts. I'll run exact pricing once we pick quant/profile.

Ravi: Also note enterprise blocker: Concordance requires Dedicated run inside their VPC for compliance. That changes network path and may require support for private peering and dedicated appliance. Flagging for sales/legal.

Aisha: Deliverables for PoC: 1) perf report (p50/p95/p99, resource utilization), 2) cost comparison hosted vs private, 3) setup/runbook, 4) short video of tail behavior, 5) security questionnaire answers.

Jun: Draft runbook excerpt: 
1) Reserve infra: 3 nodes/region (2 active + 1 spare)
2) Deploy quant model: rwd-open-7b q8_256
3) Enable prefix caching for repeated 64-token header
4) Warmup: 50 qps for 10m, validate health
5) Ramp to 400 qps over 5m, hold 30m, inject microbursts
6) Capture per-request logs, GPU metrics, and cold-start traces

Ravi: Pricing team will need tokens/sec, exact SKU IDs, and expected sustained hours per month. Jun please add tokens/sec and SKU list to the final report.

Jun: Will include tokens/sec, SKU names, and a fallback plan: if p95 rises >120ms, fallback to quantized lower-latency model variant or increase nodes.

Aisha: I'll confirm schedule with Concordance and get back by EOD Tue. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
